title: Read the executor before signal handling is added
description: You distinguish declared control signals from the counting program that currently runs.

steps.description: You define expression and statement nodes, including Break and Continue. BreakSignal and ContinueSignal are separate exception classes.
You evaluate numbers, variables, and binary operations. Assignment updates env, Print displays a value, and Block executes its statements in order.
You read While's condition check and body call. The signal handlers remain TODOs, while Break and Continue already raise their respective signals.

steps.question: Does the constructed prog contain a Break or Continue node?
steps.answer: It contains assignment, a While, a body assignment, and a Print. Its body only increments and prints n.

steps.description: You execute the supplied counting program inside an outer exception handler. That handler reports a signal if one escapes.
You inspect the recording, which prints Counting to 10 with no break yet and the values through 10. The signal-handling TODOs remain unchanged.
